name: Formulae Familiarity
body:
Your understanding of certain formulae is second nature.

Prerequisite(s): Extract class feature.

Benefit(s): Choose a number of extracts equal to your Intelligence modifier; you can prepare these extracts without referring to a formulae book. Whenever you gain a level, you can change the formulae you selected with this feat.

Normal: Without this feat, you must use a formulae book to prepare all your extracts.
